mentions.name: Invoke
mentions.description: A macOS tool for building shortcuts and custom functionality for most macOS apps. Users write JavaScript snippets that instantiate an app by bundle ID, query UI elements such as windows and buttons by role or other queries, and perform actions like pressing a button, with everything bindable to highly specific shortcuts such as press-and-hold cmd plus mouse wheel scrolling. Includes a collection of snippets that starts an MCP server exposing basic functionality for AI use.
mentions.audience: Music producers and AI (via a snippet collection that starts an MCP server), targeted in the beginning.
mentions.source_excerpt: Tool that lets you build shortcuts and custom functionality for most macOS apps.
